svg.title: A passage missing from the report is not a clean report
svg.desc: A report of seven passages with one missing. A log reader reads what the report holds, jumps over the gap without reading it and ends in a check: fine. probity-verify reads the report against the source capture, halts at the gap and returns contradicted, reason selected_span_missing_from_record: the selected passage is not in the report.
